title: Evidence-Grounded Clinical Pharmacogenomics Decision Support: Integrating Fine-Tuned Large Language Models with Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation
task: PGx QA: LoRA fine-tuning + hybrid RAG (lexical filter + all-MiniLM-L6-v2 rerank) on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B
knowledge_sources: CPIC DB tables (fine-tuning + retrieval); ClinPGx guideline text scraped via Playwright (retrieval)
evidence_note: TARGET PAPER. Free-text RAG answers; no executed rules or genotype calling. ClinPGx text covers DPWG but conflicts not handled. Prompt asks model to flag insufficient evidence (Sec 3.11) but this is not evaluated; abstention under insufficient/conflicting evidence listed as future work (Sec 6.7). Retrieval noise noted qualitatively only (Sec 6.6). Record-level split with gene/drug overlap across splits (Sec 6.5). Primary labels: rule-normalised 3 classes (decreased/increased/no significant association), 1000 held-out records. Judge: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2. Manual review: 20 prompts by research team, no inter-rater agreement.
relation_to_pgxtrust: Paper being extended. Reproduce its RAG/LoRA arms on version-pinned data; its future work motivates temporal and conflict questions.

title: Validated skills are necessary but not sufficient for trustworthy agentic genomics (revision title; earlier: Trustworthy agentic genomics through versioned skill libraries)
venue: Cell Genomics (under revision, CELL-GENOMICS-D-26-00551); repo + Zenodo
task: Matched 5-cell comparison: knowledge (none / retrieved CPIC prose / structured rules) x mechanism (LLM generates / code executes); 110 CPIC Level A cases x 8 LLMs x 3 reps
knowledge_sources: CPIC Level A; PharmGKB; PyPGx real-genome arm; PharmCAT concordance
evidence_note: CLOSEST COMPETITOR. RESULTS-REVISION.md (fetched 2026-10-09): executed CPIC mapping ~0.97 recommendation accuracy; RAG generation 0.55 with 137 lethal-class errors vs 54 for free generation. Under execution, residual error localises to the calling/input-interpretation step (call concordance 0.958). PharmCAT concordance 83/83 where both emit; PharmCAT abstains on 4. Adversarial scrambled/reversed specs = partial counterfactual. CPIC only (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.21710055 does not mention DPWG). Argues for versioned skills (model retirement) but public results contain no guideline-version-drift experiment. RAG used for answering; explanations not evaluated. Founder conflict of interest (ClawBio) declared. Not yet peer reviewed.
relation_to_pgxtrust: Pre-empts 'executable rules beat RAG' and failure attribution. PGxTrust must cite it and not claim those; its CPIC-only, single-version design leaves version drift and DPWG open.

short_cite: PharmCAT (Sangkuhl et al. 2019; Li et al. 2022)
title: Pharmacogenomics Clinical Annotation Tool (PharmCAT)
venue: Clin Pharmacol Ther (tool papers); software v3.4.0 2026-07-14
task: Deterministic VCF -> named alleles -> diplotype -> phenotype/activity score -> guideline recommendation report
knowledge_sources: CPIC; DPWG via ClinPGx curated annotations; FDA labels via ClinPGx
evidence_note: docs/methods/Matching-Recommendations.md: CPIC and DPWG annotations are tagged by source and grouped by drug; no reconciliation of disagreements. Guideline data pinned per release. title: CPIC database, API and versioned data releases
